findings.finding: Mail delivery warnings and Outlook test messages show direct mailbox configuration/testing activity. Three Outlook test messages for the historical individual HR mailbox occur in May 2026.
findings.interpretation: Supports mailbox migration/configuration activity; does not by itself identify the reason.

findings.finding: One-time-passcode messages show encrypted-message access was used for protected external correspondence.
HR scheduled Zoom meetings for internal/external coordination.
Eight job-order closure notices show RTEC posted dispatcher/transit-driver roles across multiple Kentucky service areas; closed orders could be refreshed for another 30 days.
A June 2026 security alert for the shared HR Google account was copied to the historical individual HR mailbox because that mailbox was configured as the recovery email.
findings.interpretation: Verify that recovery ownership is intentional and current; do not infer compromise.

findings.finding: Google appeal-received and appeal-approved messages show account-restoration activity using the historical mailbox as a contact address.
findings.interpretation: Account-access continuity evidence; exact affected account should not be inferred beyond the message text.

findings.finding: An Indeed Senior Account Executive contacted RTEC HR about year-end hiring demand.
findings.interpretation: Vendor/recruiting outreach only; not proof of paid service or adoption.

findings.finding: An introductory meeting with RTEC HR was scheduled.

security_followups.question: Is the historical individual HR mailbox still the intended recovery contact for the shared HR Google account? If not, update recovery ownership through the authorized account-admin process.
Why was the historical HR mailbox being actively tested in Outlook in May 2026, and is it still intended to remain a live mailbox/account?
Should the HR mailbox use automated spam/phishing triage? A concentrated 2026 unsolicited-message cluster is mixed into operational mail.
